name: PitchBook
description: PitchBook is a market-intelligence platform providing data and analytics on private and public capital markets (companies, deals, investors, funds, LPs), offered on-demand via a paid REST API/Datafeed and, more recently, an MCP server for AI assistants.
auth_methods: API key / auth token (provisioned by a PitchBook account manager, not self-generated)
gating_notes: The API is a separate, paid add-on requiring a standalone contract on top of a PitchBook platform subscription. There is no public signup form or free tier; access (including a sandbox key) is requested by contacting your PitchBook account manager or via 'My PitchBook > Plugins & Apps > PitchBook API' inside the paid platform, after which the account manager provisions credentials.
mcp_notes: PitchBook runs an official remote MCP server at https://premium.mcp.pitchbook.com/mcp (Streamable HTTP transport) exposing tools such as get_company, get_financials, search_companies, search_deals, and search_investors — but it still requires an active PitchBook account/subscription and API credentials to authenticate. PitchBook also announced (Nov 2025) an MCP-based connector integration with OpenAI/ChatGPT for its subscribers (PitchBook Navigator).
blocker: Both the REST API and the official MCP server sit behind a paid PitchBook subscription plus a separate contracted add-on; credentials are manually provisioned by an account manager rather than obtainable through self-serve signup, and full endpoint documentation is not publicly published — Composio could integrate technically (REST/JSON, MCP already exists) but cannot offer instant/self-serve credential access.
